name: Amaya Haruno
source:
For some reason, she quit her job and stayed in her ex-boyfriend's house to live with him, but after half a year there was still no sign of reemployment. Her ex-boyfriend kicked her out.

She was at a loss with no money, job, or house, and was invited to live with a strange man passing by who said: "I guarantee all the clothes, food, and shelter, so why don't you become my cat?"

[Translated from [url=http://dswtc.web.fc2.com/game/nekonare/nekonare.html]official website[/url]]
